arxiv-2109-03888.title: Sparsity and Sentence Structure in Encoder-Decoder Attention of Summarization Systems
arxiv-2109-03888.creator: Potsawee Manakul and Mark J. F. Gales
arxiv-2109-03888.description: Abstract Transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art results in a wide range of NLP tasks including summarization. Training and inference using large transformer models can be computationally expensive. Previous work has focused on one important bottleneck, the quadratic self-attention mechanism in the encoder. Modified encoder architectures such as LED or LoBART use local attention patterns to address this problem for summarization.

arxiv-2201-01979.title: ∞ \infty -Categorical Approaches to Hodge-Iwasawa Theory I: Introduction and Extensions
arxiv-2201-01979.creator: Xin Tong
arxiv-2201-01979.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper, we give the introduction to the Hodge-Iwasawa Theory introduced by the author. After that we will give some well-defined extensions to the already shaped framework established in our previous work. Chapter 1 Preliminary Discussion 1.1 Preliminary 1.1.1 Preliminary This paper is a study of geometric and representation theoretic aspects of the corresponding p -adic motives.

arxiv-2210-16308.title: Simulations of light distribution on new instrumented baffles surrounding Virgo end mirrors
arxiv-2210-16308.creator: A. Macquet, M. Andrés-Carcasona, M. Martínez, Ll.M. Mir, A. Romero-Rodríguez, H. Yamamoto
arxiv-2210-16308.description: Abstract As part of the second phase of Advanced Virgo upgrade program, instrumented baffles are being constructed to be installed around the end mirrors in the main arms, in continuation of what has been implemented for the input mode cleaner end mirror during phase I.

arxiv-2305-14204.title: MultiSCOPE: Disambiguating In-Hand Object Poses with Proprioception and Tactile Feedback
arxiv-2305-14204.creator: Author Names Omitted for Anonymous Review. Paper-ID 386, Andrea Sipos, Nima Fazeli
arxiv-2305-14204.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a method for estimating in-hand object poses using proprioception and tactile feedback from a bimanual robotic system. Our method addresses the problem of reducing pose uncertainty through a sequence of frictional contact interactions between the grasped objects.

arxiv-2310-10545.title: Optimal vintage factor analysis with deflation varimax
arxiv-2310-10545.creator: Xin Bing, Xin He, Dian Jin, Yuqian Zhang
arxiv-2310-10545.description: Abstract Vintage factor analysis is one important type of factor analysis that aims to first find a low-dimensional representation of the original data, and then to seek a rotation such that the rotated low-dimensional representation is scientifically meaningful. Perhaps the most widely used vintage factor analysis is the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) followed by the varimax rotation.

arxiv-2503-08047.title: Diffusion Approximation for Slow-Fast SDEs with State-Dependent Switching
arxiv-2503-08047.creator: Xiaobin Sun, Jue Wang, Yingchao Xie
arxiv-2503-08047.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the diffusion approximation for slow-fast stochastic differential equations with state-dependent switching, where the slow component X ε X^{\varepsilon} is the solution of a stochastic differential equation with additional homogenization term, while the fast component α ε \alpha^{\varepsilon} is a switching process.

arxiv-2510-23974.title: Diffusion Adaptive Text Embedding for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
arxiv-2510-23974.creator: Byeonghu Na, Minsang Park, Gyuwon Sim, Donghyeok Shin, HeeSun Bae Mina Kang Se Jung Kwon Wanmo Kang Il-Chul Moon
arxiv-2510-23974.description: Abstract Text-to-image diffusion models rely on text embeddings from a pre-trained text encoder, but these embeddings remain fixed across all diffusion timesteps, limiting their adaptability to the generative process. We propose Diffusion Adaptive Text Embedding (DATE), which dynamically updates text embeddings at each diffusion timestep based on intermediate perturbed data.

arxiv-2511-18069.title: Hydrogen diffusion in TiCr 2 H x Laves phases: A combined ab initio and machine-learning-potential study
arxiv-2511-18069.creator: Pranav Kumar, Fritz Körmann, Kaveh Edalati, Blazej Grabowski, Yuji Ikeda
arxiv-2511-18069.description: Abstract The kinetics of hydrogen diffusion in C15 cubic and C14 hexagonal TiCr 2 ​ H x \text{TiCr}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{x\/}}} (0 < < x ≤ \leq 4) Laves-phase hydrogen storage alloys is investigated with density functional theory (DFT) and machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs).

arxiv-2604-23596.creator: Felix Brandt, Carolin Mehlmann

britannica-1911-aesop.title: Aesop (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-aesop.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-aesop.description: Article 'Aesop' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Aesop must have received his freedom from Iadmon, or he could not have conducted the public defence of a certain Samian demagogue (Aristotle, Rhetoric, ii. According to the story, he subsequently lived at the court of Croesus, where he met Solon, and dined in the company of the Seven Sages of Greece with Periander at Corinth.

britannica-1911-corfe-castle.title: Corfe Castle (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-corfe-castle.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-corfe-castle.description: Article 'Corfe Castle' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Dorsetshire, England, in the district called the Isle of Purbeck, 129½ m. from London by the London & South-Western railway. The castle, through which the town is famous, guarded a gap in the line of considerable hills which rise in the centre of Purbeck. It is strongly placed on an eminence falling almost sheer on three sides.

pmc-10608047.title: A Feasibility Study of CT-Guided Osteosynthesis under Local Anesthesia
pmc-10608047.creator: Joris Lavigne, Nicolas Stacoffe, Damien Heidelberg, Philippe Wagner, Jean-Baptiste Pialat
pmc-10608047.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: Evaluation of local anesthesia for perioperative pain control in patients undergoing CT-guided percutaneous osteosynthesis. Methods: A total of 12 patients underwent percutaneous osteosynthesis under local anesthesia. Intraoperative pain was assessed after the procedure using numerical rating scale (NRS).

pmc-10709577.title: Diagnosing lagophthalmos using artificial intelligence
pmc-10709577.creator: Leonard Knoedler, Michael Alfertshofer, Siddharth Simon, Lukas Prantl, Andreas Kehrer, Cosima C Hoch, Samuel Knoedler, Philipp Lamby
pmc-10709577.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Lagophthalmos is the incomplete closure of the eyelids posing the risk of corneal ulceration and blindness. Lagophthalmos is a common symptom of various pathologies. We aimed to program a convolutional neural network to automatize lagophthalmos diagnosis. From June 2019 to May 2021, prospective data acquisition was performed on 30 patients seen at the Department of Plastic, Hand, and Reconstructive Surgery at the University Hospital Regensburg, Germany (IRB reference number: 20-2081-101).

pmc-11381587.title: The relationship between semen quality in male infertility clinic patients and bisphenol A：A Chinese cross-sectional study
pmc-11381587.creator: Zhiqiang Tian, Zhiwen He, QingQuan Zhang, Ling Ding, Li Song, Ruimin Ren, Kai Tan, Shifu Cao, JinTao Wang, Baolong Pan
pmc-11381587.description: Bisphenol A (BPA) is a growing concern as an endocrine-disrupting chemical due to its adverse health effects. However, the association between BPA and sperm quality in adult human males remains unclear. The aim of this study was to assess the daily life exposure level of BPA and analyze its correlation with sperm quality in males.

pmc-11605759.title: Impact of blood eosinophil count on clinical outcomes in hospitalized Syrian patients with COPD exacerbation
pmc-11605759.creator: Sara Albuaini, Michel Najjar, Dania Tulaiba, Hussam Al Bardan
pmc-11605759.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveIn this multicenter retrospective study, we evaluated the prognostic role of blood eosinophil count on clinical outcomes in hospitalized patients with exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).MethodsWe included patients aged 20 to 90 years with a COPD diagnosis. Patients were divided into groups with blood eosinophil count ≤300 or >300 cells/μL and then further classified into 1–99, 100–300, or >300 cells/μL.

pmc-11656885.title: Satisfaction of academic medical staff with integrated medical curriculum: an exploratory multinational survey
pmc-11656885.creator: Ghazi F Sharkas, Ragaa El-Masry, Sameh Abdel-Ghany, Ayman El Baz, Tamer Abou-Elsaad, Amira Adly Kassab, Darwish H Badran, Abdalla Y Bashir
pmc-11656885.description: BackgroundThe adoption of integrated curricula in medical schools has grown globally, emphasizing the need to understand academic medical staff satisfaction as a crucial factor influencing successful implementation.AimThis study aimed to assess satisfaction levels among academic medical staff with integrated medical curricula, identifying socio-demographic and work-related predictors of dissatisfaction.

pmc-12605617.title: Chest CT imaging for differentiating normal, PRISm, and COPD in comparison with pulmonary function tests
pmc-12605617.creator: Zongjing Ma, Yingli Sun, Zhuangxuan Ma, Ling Zhang, Fanzhi Cheng, Haihong Ma, Liang Jin, Ming Li
pmc-12605617.description: BackgroundPreserved ratio impaired spirometry (PRISm) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) are progressive respiratory disorders associated with accelerated pulmonary function decline and systemic comorbidities. This multicenter study aimed to develop a three-category classification model that integrates clinical variables with thoracic computed tomography (CT) radiomics to distinguish normal pulmonary function, PRISm, and COPD.

pmc-12615757.title: Fabric–elasticity relationships of femoral head trabecular bone are similar in Type 2 diabetes and non-diabetic individuals
pmc-12615757.creator: Mathieu Simon, Sasidhar Uppuganti, Jeffry S Nyman, Philippe Zysset
pmc-12615757.description: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is a chronic disease leading to an elevated glucose level in the blood and increased fracture risk. Because T2D individuals tend to have normal to higher areal bone mineral density (aBMD) than healthy individuals, their fracture risk is often underestimated.

pmc-12703124.title: When Should I Be Associating a Lateral Extra‐Articular Procedure to My Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction? AI vs. Surgeon Decision‐Making
pmc-12703124.creator: Simone Giusti, Marco Susca, Andreas Luchetti, Salvatore Congiusta, Ezio Adriani, Giuseppe Rovere
pmc-12703124.description: PurposeResidual rotational instability following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) remains a clinical challenge, leading to renewed interest in adjunctive lateral extra‐articular procedures (LEAP). This study aimed to compare clinical decision‐making between experienced orthopaedic surgeons and an artificial intelligence (AI) model regarding indications for LEAP in ACLR, to assess concordance, and to explore the potential role of AI in surgical planning.

pmc-12857670.title: Improving Braden Scale Risk Assessment Documentation: A Two-Cycle Clinical Audit at Al-Managil Teaching Hospital, Sudan
pmc-12857670.creator: Hala Omer Mohammed Taha, Amani Abdallah Alhajj Abdallah, Salih Ahmed, Mohammed Abdalazeem Alsheikh Ahmed, Muram Mustafa Mohamed Mohamed, Husam Eldin Abuelgassim Hassan Balila, Sanaa Mohammedelbager Mahmoud Mursy, Mohamed Ziada, Mohamed Mahde, Malaz Siddeg Hamed Younis, Hago Ahmed Mohamedali Ahmed, A
pmc-12857670.description: Background: Accurate Braden Scale documentation is essential for early identification of patients at risk for pressure injuries. Initial observations at Al-Managil Teaching Hospital in Al Managil, Sudan, indicated poor compliance with the Braden Scale assessment and documentation.Objectives: To evaluate the completeness of Braden Scale documentation before and after a targeted educational and documentation-standardization intervention.

pmc-13582454.title: Predictive value of serum HBcrAg in antiviral therapy for chronic hepatitis B
pmc-13582454.creator: Shiyu Wang, Hongxiao Hao, Wen Deng, Lu Zhang, Weihua Cao, Ziyu Zhang, Xinxin Li, Yaqin Zhang, Xin Wei, Linmei Yao, Zixuan Gao, Shuojie Wang, Minghui Li
pmc-13582454.description: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a significant global public health challenge. The goals of its antiviral therapy are gradually shifting from long-term viral suppression toward achieving safer treatment discontinuation, more accurate risk stratification, and deeper functional cure. Traditional serological markers, such as HBV DNA and HBsAg, remain clinically important in CHB.

pmc-13583646.title: Influence of Mother's Self-Efficacy, Social Support & Intention on Exclusive Breastfeeding: A Systematic Review
pmc-13583646.creator: Monika, S Malar Kodi, Prasuna Jelly, Chandrakala Sankarapandian, Anand Lakshminarasimhan
pmc-13583646.description: Breastmilk is widely considered to be the best source of nutrition for infants. Psychosocial factors such as maternal attitude, intention, self-efficacy and social support may influence EBF practice. The study aimed to examine the influence of mothers' self-efficacy, social support, and intention on their decision to breastfeed exclusively.

pmc-13645403.title: Prevalence and Temporal Trends of Deformational Plagiocephaly and Brachycephaly in Finland: A Population-Based Register Study
pmc-13645403.creator: Pia Vuola, Arja Heliövaara, Turkka Kirjavainen, Niklas Pakkasjärvi, Annukka Ritvanen, Erkki Tukiainen, Mika Gissler
pmc-13645403.description: This nationwide population-based study evaluated national trends in the prevalence of deformational plagiocephaly (DP) and deformational brachycephaly (DB) in Finland, using comprehensive registry data. We analyzed 1,453,780 births in Finland between 1987 and 2010. We identified 467 children diagnosed with DP or DB, including one stillbirth. Data were obtained from national health registers and supplemented with individual medical record reviews.
